name: schema-org-commerce
label: Schema.org Commerce
description: Google/Bing/Yahoo semantic markup — required for Google Shopping
short_description: Google/Bing/Yahoo semantic markup — required for Google Shopping
long_description: Google/Bing/Yahoo semantic markup — required for Google Shopping
when_to_use: Use when building applications that need to conform to the Schema.org Commerce standard.

table_notes.sorg_organization: Represents a business or brand entity per schema.org/Organization; used as the seller and brand reference across offers and products.
table_notes.sorg_product: A sellable item per schema.org/Product; holds identifiers (SKU, GTIN, MPN), brand linkage, and aggregate review data used in Google Shopping markup.
table_notes.sorg_offer: A specific price/availability listing for a product from a seller per schema.org/Offer; drives Google Shopping price feeds and structured data.
table_notes.sorg_order: A customer purchase transaction per schema.org/Order; records payment, status, totals, and address snapshots at time of purchase.
table_notes.sorg_order_item: A single line item within an order per schema.org/OrderItem; links an offer to an order with quantity and fulfillment status.
table_notes.sorg_review: A customer review and star rating for a product per schema.org/Review; contributes to aggregate ratings shown in Google search results.

sorg_organization.name: id
sorg_organization.description: Auto-incremented surrogate key for the organization

sorg_organization.name: legal_name
sorg_organization.description: Registered legal name, if different from trading name (schema.org/legalName)

sorg_organization.name: url
sorg_organization.description: Canonical website URL for the organization (schema.org/url)

sorg_organization.name: logo_url
sorg_organization.description: Absolute URL of the organization logo used in structured data (schema.org/logo)

sorg_organization.name: email
sorg_organization.description: Primary contact email address (RFC 5321 max 320 chars)

sorg_organization.name: telephone
sorg_organization.description: Contact phone number in E.164 or local format (schema.org/telephone)

sorg_organization.name: address
sorg_organization.description: Postal address as schema.org/PostalAddress object: {streetAddress, addressLocality, addressRegion, postalCode, addressCountry}

sorg_organization.name: same_as
sorg_organization.description: Array of URLs for the same entity on other sites (e.g. Wikipedia, Wikidata, social profiles) per schema.org/sameAs

sorg_product.name: id
sorg_product.description: Auto-incremented surrogate key for the product

sorg_product.name: name
sorg_product.description: Product title as shown to customers and in search snippets (schema.org/name)

sorg_product.name: description
sorg_product.description: Full product description used in structured data markup (schema.org/description)

sorg_product.name: sku
sorg_product.description: Merchant-assigned Stock Keeping Unit; unique per product variant (schema.org/sku)

sorg_product.name: gtin
sorg_product.description: Global Trade Item Number (EAN-13/UPC-12/GTIN-14) per GS1 standard (schema.org/gtin)

sorg_product.name: mpn
sorg_product.description: Manufacturer Part Number assigned by the producer (schema.org/mpn)

sorg_product.name: brand_id
sorg_product.description: References sorg_organization; identifies the brand that makes this product

sorg_product.name: category
sorg_product.description: Product category path, ideally using Google Product Taxonomy strings (schema.org/category)

sorg_product.name: image_url
sorg_product.description: Absolute URL of the primary product image (schema.org/image)

sorg_product.name: additional_images
sorg_product.description: Array of additional image URLs for variant or angle shots: ["https://...", ...]

sorg_product.name: aggregate_rating
sorg_product.description: Rolled-up rating per schema.org/AggregateRating: {ratingValue, reviewCount, bestRating, worstRating}

sorg_product.name: is_related_to
sorg_product.description: Array of product IDs or URLs of related products (schema.org/isRelatedTo)

sorg_product.name: is_similar_to
sorg_product.description: Array of product IDs or URLs of similar/comparable products (schema.org/isSimilarTo)

sorg_offer.name: id
sorg_offer.description: Auto-incremented surrogate key for the offer

sorg_offer.name: product_id
sorg_offer.description: References sorg_product; the item being offered for sale

sorg_offer.name: seller_id
sorg_offer.description: References sorg_organization; the merchant making this offer

sorg_offer.name: price
sorg_offer.description: Offer price with four decimal places for currency precision (schema.org/price)

sorg_offer.name: price_currency
sorg_offer.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the price (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP)

sorg_offer.name: price_valid_until
sorg_offer.description: Date after which this price is no longer valid (schema.org/priceValidUntil)

sorg_offer.name: availability
sorg_offer.description: Stock status using schema.org values: InStock, OutOfStock, PreOrder, BackOrder, Discontinued

sorg_offer.name: item_condition
sorg_offer.description: Product condition using schema.org values: NewCondition, UsedCondition, RefurbishedCondition, DamagedCondition

sorg_offer.name: shipping
sorg_offer.description: Shipping details per schema.org/OfferShippingDetails: {shippingRate, deliveryTime, shippingDestination}

sorg_offer.name: eligible_region
sorg_offer.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code where this offer is valid (schema.org/eligibleRegion)

sorg_order.name: id
sorg_order.description: UUID primary key for the order (stable reference for customer-facing links)

sorg_order.name: order_number
sorg_order.description: Human-readable order reference shown to customers (schema.org/orderNumber)

sorg_order.name: order_date
sorg_order.description: Timestamp when the order was placed, stored with timezone (schema.org/orderDate)

sorg_order.name: customer_id
sorg_order.description: Application-level foreign key to the customer/user record

sorg_order.name: order_status
sorg_order.description: Fulfillment status using schema.org/OrderStatus values: OrderProcessing, OrderShipped, OrderDelivered, OrderCancelled

sorg_order.name: payment_method
sorg_order.description: Payment instrument used, e.g. CreditCard, PayPal, BankTransfer (schema.org/paymentMethod)

sorg_order.name: discount_code
sorg_order.description: Coupon or promotional code applied to this order

sorg_order.name: price_total
sorg_order.description: Order grand total including tax and shipping (schema.org/price)

sorg_order.name: price_currency
sorg_order.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary fields in this order

sorg_order.name: billing_address
sorg_order.description: Billing address snapshot at time of purchase per schema.org/PostalAddress: {streetAddress, addressLocality, postalCode, addressCountry}

sorg_order.name: shipping_address
sorg_order.description: Delivery address snapshot at time of purchase per schema.org/PostalAddress: {streetAddress, addressLocality, postalCode, addressCountry}

sorg_order_item.name: id
sorg_order_item.description: Auto-incremented surrogate key for the order line item

sorg_order_item.name: order_id
sorg_order_item.description: References sorg_order; the parent order this line item belongs to

sorg_order_item.name: offer_id
sorg_order_item.description: References sorg_offer; the specific price listing that was purchased

sorg_order_item.name: order_quantity
sorg_order_item.description: Number of units ordered for this offer (schema.org/orderQuantity)

sorg_order_item.name: order_item_status
sorg_order_item.description: Per-line fulfillment status using schema.org/OrderStatus values (may differ from parent order)

sorg_order_item.name: unit_price
sorg_order_item.description: Price per unit at time of purchase, snapshotted to handle future price changes

sorg_review.name: id
sorg_review.description: Auto-incremented surrogate key for the review

sorg_review.name: product_id
sorg_review.description: References sorg_product; the product being reviewed

sorg_review.name: rating_value
sorg_review.description: Numeric star rating given by the reviewer (schema.org/ratingValue)

sorg_review.name: best_rating
sorg_review.description: Maximum possible rating on this scale; defaults to 5 (schema.org/bestRating)

sorg_review.name: review_body
sorg_review.description: Full text of the written review (schema.org/reviewBody)

sorg_review.name: date_published
sorg_review.description: Date the review was published or submitted (schema.org/datePublished)

sorg_review.name: is_verified
sorg_review.description: True if the reviewer was verified as a confirmed purchaser of the product
